sources.title: Textwall Quickstart + Tryhard Warwick Jungle guide
[13.8] Warwick Top // High Elo Builds, Matchup Tips and Useful Links

passive.name: Eternal Hunger
passive.text: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.

spells.name: Jaws of the Beast
spells.text: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

spells.name: Blood Hunt
spells.text: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.

spells.name: Primal Howl
spells.text: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

spells.name: Infinite Duress
spells.text: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

damage.value: Warwick deals mixed physical and magic damage through sustained autoattacks.

archetype.value: Warwick is an autoattack-reliant, strong early-game jungler.

axis.value: Warwick looks for favorable long trades.

winCondition.value: Warwick can snowball by using his early strength to draw pressure and secure kills.

spikes.why: Warwick is especially strong early and has outplay potential with his E and passives.
Warwick benefits from conserving early gold to reach his items sooner.

spikes.at: When a target falls below 25% health
spikes.why: Warwick's Blood Hunt bonuses triple against that target.

bait.why: Warwick usually uses Primal Howl only once per fight, leaving Warwick without its fear after the recast.
Warwick cannot use Jaws of the Beast to bite and heal while it is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Warwick can miss Primal Howl’s fear if Warwick misjudges its reactivation radius.
Warwick players should not copy high-Elo builds without considering the team composition.
Warwick players should not rely on Barrier to win early fights, because it is weak after level 6 and late in the game.
